snippet.title: Third Walker — Official Announce Trailer | Sci-Fi Action Reveal
snippet.description:
Third Walker — Official Announce Trailer
Experience the first look at Third Walker, a sci-fi action experience about ancient machines and human resistance. Watch the cinematic reveal and subscribe for gameplay drops, dev diaries, and launch info.

▼ About the game
Third Walker is an atmospheric single-player sci-fi action game blending mech combat and stealth. Subscribe for  updates
